hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | xargs -I{} sh -c 'f="{}"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then if grep -Eil "wells.fargo.*sonora|fabricated.transaction|restitution.award|\\$639M" "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "evidence-audit: edit target ($f) references material flagged as fabricated in the audit. Confirm provenance before propagating into new documents." >&2; fi; fi'
